description: Test prompts that verify rk-knowledge triggers and produces correct, RK35xx-aware guidance. Prompts are written the way a real Rockchip RK3588/RK3576 developer would phrase them (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: version-mismatch-is-first-suspect
evals.prompt: 我在 RK3588 上跑 rknn 模型，rknn_init 报 load model failed / 版本不匹配，模型是我自己转的，怎么排查？
evals.expected_output: Leads with the toolkit2-vs-librknnrt version match as the first thing to check, with concrete version-check commands, before suspecting the model.

assertions.text: Identifies a PC-toolkit (rknn-toolkit2) vs board-runtime (librknnrt) version mismatch as the most likely cause.
Says to make the two versions match — either re-convert with the matching toolkit2 or upgrade librknnrt + the NPU driver on the board.
Does NOT jump to blaming the model architecture as the first step.

evals.name: tops-is-whole-npu-not-per-core
evals.prompt: RK3588 不是标称 6 TOPS 吗，为什么我一个模型跑起来好像只用了一部分算力？
evals.expected_output: Explains 6 TOPS is the whole 3-core NPU, default AUTO uses one core, and how to use all of it via core_mask / multiple instances.

assertions.text: States the 6 TOPS is the whole NPU which has 3 cores (not 6 TOPS per core).
Explains a single model on default NPU_CORE_AUTO runs on one core (~1/3 of the NPU).
Says to use the full NPU by setting core_mask (e.g. NPU_CORE_0_1_2) or running multiple instances pinned to different cores.

evals.name: yolov8-deploy-flow
evals.prompt: 怎么把我训练的 YOLOv8 部署到 Orange Pi 5（RK3588）上跑？
evals.expected_output: Two-stage flow: PC-side convert to .rknn with rknn-toolkit2 and target_platform=rk3588, board-side run with rknn-toolkit-lite2; recommends the airockchip fork for export.

assertions.text: Says to convert on a PC with rknn-toolkit2 to a .rknn, with target_platform set to rk3588.
Says to run on the board with rknn-toolkit-lite2 (or librknnrt C API).
Recommends exporting YOLO ONNX from the airockchip fork (e.g. airockchip/ultralytics_yolov8) for an RKNN-friendly head.

evals.name: llm-is-separate-sdk
evals.prompt: 我想在 RK3588 上跑 Qwen 大模型，用 rknn-toolkit2 转一下就行吗？
evals.expected_output: No — LLMs use the separate RKNN-LLM SDK (rkllm-toolkit / .rkllm / librkllmrt), not rknn-toolkit2.

assertions.text: Says rknn-toolkit2 is not the right tool for LLMs (it is for CNN/vision models).
Points to the separate RKNN-LLM SDK (rkllm-toolkit / .rkllm / librkllmrt) for running an LLM on RK3588.

evals.name: rknn-on-pypi-and-platform-specific
evals.prompt: rknn-toolkit2 现在能直接 pip install 吗？转好的 .rknn 能 RK3588 和 RK3576 通用吗？
evals.expected_output: Yes, rknn-toolkit2 is on PyPI (2.3.x); but a .rknn is platform-specific — target_platform must match, RK3588 and RK3576 are not interchangeable.

assertions.text: Confirms rknn-toolkit2 is installable from PyPI (pip install rknn-toolkit2), latest 2.3.x.
States a .rknn is platform-specific: target_platform must match the SoC, so an rk3588 model does not run on rk3576 (and vice-versa).

evals.name: rk-probe-script-verification
evals.prompt: 怎么确认我的板子是 RK3588 还是 RK3576？NPU 驱动有没有加载？
evals.expected_output: References scripts/rk_probe.sh to read /proc/device-tree/model + compatible + /proc/version + dmesg rknpu, outputs structured JSON with model, soc, kernel, npu_driver fields.

assertions.text: References scripts/rk_probe.sh as the tool to identify the RK board and check NPU driver status.
Mentions the JSON output fields: model, soc, kernel, npu_driver.
Notes the script is read-only and idempotent (safe to run without side effects).
